help: the check suite over src/ and rsc/ - code and schema, the same on any clone; the corpus is the data gate's (corpus-yoga pipeline run) (also what the pre-commit hook runs); the checks of what arrives from outside run the grammar's tool and, when a docker daemon is reachable, the mcp reproduction, each under its own verb's declared sends, which CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND=1 refuses without failing the run

args.name: --fix
args.help: run every fix command, then stop - stages nothing (review and stage yourself)

args.name: --fresh
args.help: ignore the section cache and re-run every check (the cache stat-hashes each section's declared subject; unchanged sections replay)

explanation.stages: the report's tail as facts - each check section with how many invocations passed and failed, its tier, and the line where the section begins (in the full report under tmp/logs/test/run/, which the terminal's line names; in the committed report, its own line), so that a count turns back into the checks that produced it
